what: Master Version 2.55 — COTT's dealer-displays page (dealer-displays-a) laid out entry by entry against the master. SE-22 (PW - Service Tools), 77, 401, 404, 925, 1254 and D-102 already had rows. Six had none and are added at the bottom of Lionel PW - Items, set up like the other dealer displays (Promotional / Dealer Display, COTT bookmark link, COTT text): LP Lionel-Porter Key Wallet (no Lionel number — COTT's bookmark name, as the dealer ashtray uses ASH; SS0342), D-20 Accessory Display Panel, D-21 027 Track and Switches Display, 187 Ferris Wheel Dealer Display, D-165 Dealer Display, D-224 Dealer Display. D-102 (WSHHR3ES6G) was typed and named "Accessory": now Promotional / Dealer Display, Control cleared, Description "D-102 Display". Original COTT Desc that ran on into the next entries is trimmed back to each item's own entry on 77 (E3W8PJXRYJ, held the 187 text), 404 (F3HTYY2H2W, held 925's heading + key wallet / D-20 / D-21 / SE-22) and 1254 (EXZJEETW3D, held D-102 / D-165 / D-224).
